about: Shared vectors for the XRPL payment rules (xrpl-payment/1). Checked by cargo test (verify::tests::t36_shared_vectors) and by src/lib/desk/__tests__/payment-hosted.test.ts, so the desktop engine and the hosted API decide and digest identically. Entries with `fixture` are REAL mainnet account_tx entries, by index into tests/fixtures/account-tx-solo-107587061.json. Entries named `synthetic:` are SYNTHETIC rippled `tx` (API v2) replies built to cover cases no recorded transaction does; they are not ledger evidence. `expected` is written by the Rust engine (NOSHASHI_WRITE_VECTORS=1 cargo test ... t36) and then frozen.
